title: Podcast Episode: Our Gradual Disempowerment
author: Lee Fang
content:
Le Pod lives. After a short hiatus, we're back with another episode about the
dangers of artificial intelligence. When does a wonderful tool for the
betterment of society become a dangerous dependency as we outsource our daily
tasks, our cognitive abilities, our manufacturing, and our broader economy to
technological entities that are no longer under our control?

The last time we spoke about this, we focused on existential risks. This week,
we're joined by University of Montreal Assistant Professor David Krueger, who
has raised alarm bells about the risks of "gradual disempowerment."  

[ Read more ](https://www.leefang.com/p/podcast-episode-our-gradual-
